body:
The Beta Data Summary Browser is a proof-of-concept that provides a summary of the demographics and phenotypes within cohorts from the Accelerating Medicines Partnership® (AMP®) Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Common Metabolic Diseases (CMD), Parkinson's Disease and Related Disorders (PDRD), and Rheumatoid Arthritis / Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (RA/SLE) projects for which SysBio FAIRplex has generated proof-of-concept single-cell RNA-sequencing. All baseline metrics are mapped directly from clinical data available via primary source repositories. Aggregated totals vary across demographic modules based on clinical metadata completeness available from primary source repositories. 

To preserve participant privacy and ensure strict compliance across all contributing data governance policies, cell frequencies containing fewer than 20 individuals are automatically suppressed and aggregated into the "Unknown" category. This programmatic masking minimizes re-identification risks while preserving the mathematical validity of the larger sample distribution. Out of an abundance of caution, the unknown category is not available for display at this time. Hiding "Unknown" data categories means that the "Other" category also needs to be hidden; consequently, aggregated totals may vary across visualization modules.  

Select the desired AMP program(s) to begin. Large pie charts summarize each variable within the entire selected cohort across all selected AMP programs. Smaller pie charts show the breakdown of each variable within each individual selected AMP program.
